name: Alina Brace
bio: Alina Brace can be seen starring as Younger Natalie Fabelman in Steven Spielberg's semi-autobiographical film, The Fabelmans, co-written by Tony Kushner. The film received widespread critical acclaim and won top prize at the Toronto International Film Festival, where it premiered as well as the Best Motion Picture - Drama at the 2023 Golden Globes. Alina started acting in commercials when she was 5 years old and her TV acting debut was in an episode of Netflix's Sweet Magnolias in 2021.

credits.title: Lilo & Scratch
credits.overview: Stitch is tasked with looking after Scratch, a cat Lilo has found, but Scratch has more similarities with Stitch than meets the eye.

credits.title: Madden
credits.overview: Chronicles John Madden's incredible journey alongside best friend and true original Al Davis—from a Super Bowl-winning partnership with the Raiders, to becoming football's most recognizable voice, to building the worldwide Madden NFL video game.

credits.title: Popular Theory
credits.overview: Erwin, a girl genius, is the youngest student in high school. Unfortunately she struggles with social isolation. When she meets fellow science guru, Winston, they team up to invent a chemical that changes the high school hierarchy forever.

credits.title: The Fabelmans
credits.overview: Growing up in post-World War II era Arizona, young Sammy Fabelman aspires to become a filmmaker as he reaches adolescence, but soon discovers a shattering family secret and explores how the power of films can help him see the truth.
